recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: video = a video that exists (charged). error = a free row: not_found, invalid_input, playlist_not_supported, duplicate, removed or budget_exhausted.

videoId.title: Video ID
videoId.description: The 11-character YouTube video id, validated against ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{11}$. Null when the input could not be parsed.

inputUrl.title: Input
inputUrl.description: The line exactly as you gave it.

status.title: Status
status.description: ok = charged row. Free: not_found (every size 404, or the request failed), invalid_input (not a YouTube video URL or id), playlist_not_supported (playlist or channel URL), duplicate (same video earlier in the input), removed (blocklisted at a rightholder's request), budget_exhausted (maxVideos or the max total charge was reached first).

title.title: Title
title.description: Video title from YouTube's public oEmbed endpoint; null when includeMetadata is off or oEmbed did not answer.

authorName.title: Channel name
authorName.description: The channel's public display name from oEmbed. This is frequently a natural person's name — treat it as such downstream.

metadataSource.title: Metadata source
metadataSource.description: oembed when title/channel came from the oEmbed endpoint; null otherwise.

isVertical.title: Vertical
isVertical.description: True when frame0.jpg is taller than wide (a vertical Short); null when frame0 was not served.

aspectHint.title: Aspect hint
aspectHint.description: 16:9, 4:3 or 9:16 from the frame0.jpg dimensions (oEmbed 200x150 also implies 4:3); null when unknown.

best.title: Best size
best.description: The largest standard size that answered 200 on HEAD: {size, url, webpUrl, width, height, bytes, etag}. Null on error rows.

size.title: Size
size.description: maxresdefault, sddefault, hqdefault, mqdefault or default.

webpUrl.title: WebP URL
webpUrl.description: https://i.ytimg.com/vi_webp/{videoId}/{size}.webp — derived; the WebP variant shares the JPEG's availability and etag, so it is not probed separately.

width.title: Width
width.description: Pixel width. Constant per size (maxresdefault 1280, sddefault 640, hqdefault 480, mqdefault 320, default 120). oar frames are rendered at the upload's source resolution — up to 1920 (1080 for vertical videos), 1280 or smaller for older or low-resolution uploads — and are measured from the downloaded file when oar is selected, else null.

height.title: Height
height.description: Pixel height. maxresdefault is 720, not 1080. oar frames are rendered at the upload's source resolution — up to 1080 (1920 for vertical videos), 720 or smaller for older or low-resolution uploads — and are measured from the downloaded file when oar is selected, else null.

bytes.title: Bytes
bytes.description: content-length from the HEAD probe; null when unavailable.

etag.title: ETag
etag.description: The CDN etag from the HEAD probe. Changes when the creator replaces the thumbnail — a cheap change-detection key.

thumbnails.title: Thumbnails
thumbnails.description: One entry per probed size — maxresdefault, sddefault, hqdefault, mqdefault, default, oar1 (plus oar2/oar3 when sizes includes oar) — each {available, url, webpUrl, width, height, bytes, etag}. Every size is reported regardless of what you downloaded.

available.title: Available
available.description: True when the CDN answered the HEAD probe with 200. A 404 is a real status, so this is never guessed.

webpUrl.title: WebP URL
webpUrl.description: https://i.ytimg.com/vi_webp/{videoId}/{size}.webp — derived; the WebP variant shares the JPEG's availability and etag, so it is not probed separately.

width.title: Width
width.description: Pixel width. Constant per size (maxresdefault 1280, sddefault 640, hqdefault 480, mqdefault 320, default 120). oar frames are rendered at the upload's source resolution — up to 1920 (1080 for vertical videos), 1280 or smaller for older or low-resolution uploads — and are measured from the downloaded file when oar is selected, else null.

height.title: Height
height.description: Pixel height. maxresdefault is 720, not 1080. oar frames are rendered at the upload's source resolution — up to 1080 (1920 for vertical videos), 720 or smaller for older or low-resolution uploads — and are measured from the downloaded file when oar is selected, else null.

bytes.title: Bytes
bytes.description: content-length from the HEAD probe; null when unavailable.

etag.title: ETag
etag.description: The CDN etag from the HEAD probe. Changes when the creator replaces the thumbnail — a cheap change-detection key.

availableSizes.title: Available sizes
availableSizes.description: Names that exist for this video, standard sizes largest to smallest, then any oar frames.

files.title: Saved files
files.description: One entry per record written to this run's key-value store: {size, format, key, storeId, url}. The store is private to your account, so url needs ?token=<your API token> outside the Console; storeId and key are for SDK/API callers. Empty when saveImages is off.

size.title: Size
size.description: Size name of the saved file.

storeId.title: Store ID
storeId.description: The run's default key-value store id.

url.title: Record URL
url.description: https://api.apify.com/v2/key-value-stores/{storeId}/records/{key}. Private: append ?token=<your API token> to open it outside the Console.

fetchedAt.title: Fetched at
fetchedAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the probe.

errorMessage.title: Error message
errorMessage.description: Why a row is free, or which selected file could not be saved on an ok row (the URLs are still delivered).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: One row per video with the best size as an image preview.
